description:
Cast Undying Flames.
Undying Flames is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Undying Flames with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Undying Flames.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Undying Flames's Epic ability, and they can not harm you with Undying Flames due to Leyline of Sanctity.
